title: Immediate vs Scheduled Proportion
scenario: Calculate the ratio of immediate orders to scheduled orders for each customer. Return 'customer_id' and 'ratio'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Use CASE statements to sum immediate vs scheduled orders.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date = customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date < customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio FROM delivery GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN order_date < customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02'), (2, 1, '2019-08-02', '2019-08-02');
